## 4. Bayesian optimisation (HistGradientBoosting)

- Sampler: Optuna TPESampler(seed=42); CV: 3-fold GroupKFold over 80 training trips; objective: mean CV macro F1; trials: 25
- Best CV macro F1: 0.9418 (trial 0 = untuned defaults: 0.9404)
- Best parameters: learning_rate=0.0499, max_iter=600, max_leaf_nodes=115, min_samples_leaf=33, l2_regularization=0.0002014, max_features=0.4396
- Search space: learning_rate 0.02-0.3 (log), max_iter 100-600 (step 50), max_leaf_nodes 15-127,
  min_samples_leaf 10-300 (log), l2_regularization 1e-6-10 (log), max_features 0.4-1.0

| model | cv_macro_f1 | cv_top1_acc | test_top1_acc | test_macro_f1 | test_log_loss | train_time_s | inference_time_s |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| untuned (defaults) | 0.9404 | 0.9052 | 0.9026 | 0.9386 | 0.0715 | 1.2643 | 0.0685 |
| tuned (Bayesian) | 0.9418 | 0.9088 | 0.9076 | 0.9405 | 0.0697 | 10.0355 | 0.3653 |
